intent.premise: A sixty-second golden-hour-dusk healing short in the flat sunprint style (dusk variant: violet-to-orange sky, extremely long slanted shadows, warm rim light, first window lamps): on the same evening after the morning riverbank visit, the orange tabby leads the girl home over a small stone bridge and through a dusk lane neither of them used by day, told through approved 2D keyframes, 2D crop moves, four 2-3 second wan2.6-i2v standard-tier image-to-video clips played as 12fps cel sequences for the continuous-action shots (cat bank run, girl bridge walk, cat dusk wall walk, girl lane walk), procedural flat-shape sunprint layers (cloud drift, river glint bands, door-lamp pool), energy-gated Chinese viseme cels for the girl's inner monologue, and a gentle folk-guitar score that lifts at the final line. All travel is screen-left (homecoming, mirrored from E02).
intent.audience: Viewers evaluating a compact but complete 2D anime short with a stable generated heroine, a consistent orange tabby cat, a readable riverbank-to-bridge-to-lane-to-home dusk progression, and synchronized sound.
designPriorities: Keep the girl's waist-length dark-blue hair, amber eyes, white shirt, and navy plaid pleated skirt stable across every frame; no umbrella, no school bag.
Keep the orange tabby cat's white chest, white paws, and green eyes stable; it is dry and fluffy after the previous episode's rescue.
Use hard cuts for all beats so character and cat silhouettes never double through a dissolve; reserve the single closing crossfade for the final sky tilt-out shot.

Gate visible closed, half, and open mouth cels at 12 fps from the exact post-trim final dialogue stem, then select limited visemes from the known Chinese syllables, never from subtitle duration; cat meows are gated from the SFX-only cue entries 3 and 7.
Derive frame selection, mouth state, crop motion, transitions, and subtitles only from absolute story time so seeks and segmented renders remain deterministic.
Draw every procedural layer (cloud drift, dappled light, steam, door light band) as razor-clean flat vector shapes in source-image space; zero grain, zero gradients, per STYLE_BIBLE.md.

intent.location: A dusk riverbank with grassy slope and distant bridge, a small stone bridge over the river, a dusk residential lane with a white perimeter wall and first window lamps, and a home entrance with a warm door lamp, all baked into full-frame 2D artwork plus four baked-motion I2V cel sequences.
intent.timeOfDay: Late golden-hour dusk: violet-to-orange sky, very low sun, extremely long slanted shadows, warm orange-gold rim light, windows and door lamps glowing.
intent.storyFunction: Follow the cat leading the girl home at dusk: off the riverbank, over the stone bridge, through the dusk lane to the lamplit front door, closing on her asking where the cat will take her tomorrow.
visualRules: Every source PNG fills the 1920 by 1080 presentation canvas through cover-crop without aspect-ratio distortion.
The keyframe timeline, rather than equal frame division, determines every image boundary and camera-like crop move.
Each spoken line keeps one stable speaker plate; only a tight mouth rectangle changes between closed, half, and open states.
Chinese subtitles are rendered in code over text-free source art and must remain inside the lower safe area.
The scene uses a CanvasTexture as the Three.js background, so runtime camera collision geometry is intentionally inapplicable and camera obstacles remain empty.
Girl is a voice-only story speaker whose visible body is baked into the keyframes; no 3D character meshes may be layered over the artwork.
No runtime grain, noise, or texture layer may be composited over the sunprint artwork.

purpose: Represent the full-frame timed 2D presentation rather than a navigable 3D stage.

screenCenter.purpose: Stable center of the full-frame keyframe canvas.

bakedStoreDoor.purpose: Semantic screen-right automatic-door corner where the cat waits and leads the girl inside, represented inside the generated artwork.

bakedWindowBench.purpose: Semantic window-bench area used by the closing sit-together shots, represented inside the generated artwork.

lighting.mood: Bright flat sunny-morning color with complementary lavender shadows and long slanted gold light bands.
readabilityRules: Do not apply runtime lighting or grading that changes character colors between generated frames.
Keep faces, the navy and white costume silhouette, the orange cat, and the white-and-aqua storefront readable during all crop motion and transitions.
Keep subtitle contrast independent of the baked background by using a dark translucent backing and outlined white text.

audioAnchors.semantic: Morning room tone and sparrows over the first act, fading as the pair leaves home.
Daytime footsteps on the lane while the girl follows the cat; cat meows at the windowsill and steps beats.
River wind and gentle water beds from the riverbank reveal to the end; grass footsteps on the slope.

shotChecks.purpose: Confirm the morning bedroom, desk, bed and window sky fill the first frame with subtitle-safe margins.
Confirm the girl sitting up in bed is readable during the first monologue line with syllable-aware visemes.
Confirm the I2V cat-wall-walk cel sequence is playing (mid-clip frame differs from the first frame).
Confirm the girl begins the final river line on camera with syllable-aware visemes before the warm pull-out.
